2607.24341.title: Simulating Tenant Responses to Energy Policy Interventions with Transaction-Cost-Aware LLM Age
2607.24341.paper_summary: Recent studies use Large language models (LLMs) to simulate human opinions and decisions by prompting models with demographic, attitudinal, or persona-based descriptions. Yet such simulations rarely model the practical, cognitive, or social frictions that shape how people respond to policy interventions. Perceived transaction cost (PTC) provides a useful lens for modeling the practical frictions that shape policy responses, such as information burden, administrative effort, coordination demands, and perceived uncertainty. We use this lens to develop a friction-aware persona modeling approach for LLM-based simulation. In the context of energy-efficient renovation (EER), tenants are represented not only by who they are demographically, but by how they perceive the costs, benefits, barriers, and uncertainties associated with proposed renovation plans. Using survey data collected from 1,068 citizens in the Netherlands, comprising approximately 40,548 survey question and answer pairs, we compare prompt-only and fine-tuned settings across GPT-3.5-turbo, Ministral-8B-Instruct, and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and evaluate supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for local open-weight models. Results show that incorporating PTC-based personas and reasoning consistently improves model performance across both prompt-only and fine-tuned settings, suggesting that PTC-based persona design provides a useful bridge between institutional policy theory and interpretable LLM-based policy simulation. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaweijie1996/socialagent.
2607.24341.paper_summary_zh: 最近的研究使用大型語言模型（LLMs）通過提供人口統計、態度或基於角色的描述來模擬人類的意見和決策。<lb/>然而，這些模擬很少考慮塑造人們對政策干預反應的實際、認知或社會摩擦。<lb/>感知交易成本（PTC）為建模塑造政策反應的實際摩擦提供了一個有用的視角，例如信息負擔、行政努力、協調需求和感知不確定性。<lb/>我們利用這一視角開發了一種摩擦感知的角色建模方法，用於基於LLM的模擬。<lb/>在能源高效改造（EER）的背景下，租戶不僅由他們的人口統計特徵來表示，還由他們對與提議的改造計劃相關的成本、效益、障礙和不確定性的感知來表示。<lb/>使用從荷蘭收集的1,068名公民的調查數據，涵蓋約40,548對調查問題和答案，我們比較了GPT-3.5-turbo、Ministral-8B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在僅提示和微調設置下的表現，並評估了本地開放權重模型的監督微調（SFT）和群體相對政策優化（GRPO）。<lb/>結果顯示，納入基於PTC的角色和推理在僅提示和微調設置下持續改善模型性能，這表明基於PTC的角色設計為制度政策理論和可解釋的基於LLM的政策模擬之間提供了一個有用的橋樑。<lb/>代碼可在 https://github.com/xiaweijie1996/socialagent 獲得。
